tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-window gain, while the target horizon is much longer. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish sustained positive response from endogenous adaptation and constrain the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at short horizons, so the slow component and its long-horizon reversal are not reliably identified.
Fine short-time trajectories are less directly informative about the forecast at H = 23.8.
These remain plausible on the short pilot but do not establish whether a slow reversal occurs.
